text:
**A**

Response A is better. It stays within the 120-word limit (about 105 words) and keeps every key finding:

- the 22% drop in lane drifting and the 0.09-second reaction-time gain
- the benefit going mainly to experienced workers, with grogginess in new workers
- drive time mattering more than the nap
- the implication that naps don't replace earlier shift finishes or transport home
- the limitations (simulator only, mostly men aged 25–50)

Response B runs to roughly 200 words, well over the limit. It pads with restatements ("In other words…", "Put differently…") that a busy manager doesn't need. It also says "6 or more months", which slightly misstates the original's "more than six months."
